name: v2-delta-triangle
approved_by: Claude independent analytical review (scripted kinematic model; not physical-board)
review: Independent checks: all 427 block-end motor positions within 0.51 step of an inverse-kinematics calculation (250 mm arms, 124 mm radius). Per-move durations against a trapezoid model (100 mm/s^2, XY 50 mm/s, Z capped at 5 mm/s by the firmware) using recorded boundary speeds and exact lengths: 30 mm moves -0.09% and -2.46%, 42.43 mm move +0.09%, the 100 mm and 10 mm Z moves +0.01% and -0.03%. Per-segment timing is not checked individually (segments are short and step-quantized). Two simulator runs gave identical traces. Not a physical-board measurement.
